data.description: Implement repository format negotiation and immutable Chat/session/branch manifests plus bounded parent-linked JSONL segment and logical checkpoint storage. Readers must verify exact bytes, hashes, schema, bounds, ordinals, and parent linkage before exposing records; unsupported formats remain inspectable and inert.
